milestone: CUE scorer implementation (Method 1: TF-IDF+LogReg, Method 2: Fightin' Words reused)
objective: Implement the two CUE scoring methods per logs/cue_reference_audit.md's reference-data/LOSO design; freeze parameters; add focused unit tests. No final candidate batch scored.

new_artifacts.src/cue_scoring.py: TfidfLogRegCueScorer, leave_one_source_out_folds, grouped_kfold_indices, score_harmful_reference_sources_loso, compute_agreement, load_reference_texts_from_repo

leakage_control_design: 3-fold leave-one-source-out across HarmBench/StrongREJECT/SimpleSafetyTests; XSTest and quadrant D fixed on the benign side (XSTest limitation disclosed, not silently papered over); generic dedup-group-aware GroupKFold fallback for pools without distinct sources.
features_used: prompt text only (TF-IDF vectors, Fightin' Words token counts); source/category metadata used only to build folds, never as a model feature
